data.notes: Confirmed November listings currently skew toward boutique electronic weekender/club programming, with the closing day of Marrakech Jazz Experience adding a contemporary jazz anchor.

events.title: The Source Festival Weekend
events.summary: The Source’s November weekender packages two nights at the Ourika-road hotel: Glitched × The Source on Friday and Laÿla × The Source on Saturday. The confirmed Saturday bill features Dixon and Trikk.

events.title: LAŸLA Nights Marrakech: Dixon / Trikk
events.summary: LAŸLA’s “Stellar Edition” brings Dixon and Trikk to The Source for a high-production house, deep house, Afro-house and electro-house night, with Didiss, NAIT and WHOSKENZA also listed.

events.title: LAŸLA NIGHTS
events.summary: LAŸLA NIGHTS presents its Stellar Edition at The Source Marrakesh on November 7. The confirmed Resident Advisor listing names Dixon and Trikk on the lineup.

events.title: ECHO7000 — Malice at the Villa with Lola Haro and David Fogarty
events.summary: ECHO7000 hosts a 12-hour villa party with Lola Haro and David Fogarty alongside residents Miles and MARO, billed on RA as techno and electro.

events.title: Marrakech Jazz Experience
events.summary: The inaugural Marrakech Jazz Experience runs across the weekend ending November 1, with contemporary Moroccan jazz programming at Meydene and free M Avenue performances. Confirmed November programming includes Maria Naciri at M Square on November 1, alongside festival talks and concerts.

events.title: Back To House — Underground Series Vol. 3
events.summary: Back To House returns with a two-day underground house/minimal gathering near Marrakech, emphasizing deep grooves, raw energy and local-scene selectors including HearThug, Daox, bkl, Yahya, Soukii, JaKaw and Nordiks.

events.title: Sol Sundays at El Fenn
events.summary: El Fenn’s autumn rooftop residency features resident DJ Shems playing late-afternoon-to-evening sets on the medina rooftop. The official schedule lists Sunday, November 8 as one of the confirmed dates.

events.title: DREAMERS — Soul Awakening in Marrakech
events.summary: DREAMERS returns near Marrakech for a three-day intimate festival-retreat at Les Asnouss from November 20 to 22. The ticketing page categorizes it across electronic, jazz/current music, world and community programming.

events.title: Marrakech Choral Meeting 2026
events.summary: The 4th edition of Marrakech Choral Meeting is confirmed for November 6–9, 2026. The international choral festival brings choirs from around the world to perform in historic Marrakech venues, with mass-choir moments planned.

events.title: Live Music Stage at The Marrakech Coffee & Tea Festival 2026
events.summary: The Marrakech Coffee & Tea Festival lists a dedicated Music Lounge/Live Music Stage across its November 14–16, 2026 dates at Mossalla Sidi Amara. The page confirms live music, acoustic sessions and DJ performances, though the 2026 artist lineup is not yet published.
